source: make a game where you live in a small town and it is multiplayer and you go to your house and your parents sign you up for a school in a new town and when you get their everthing seems normal but then while your eating lunch you see your teacher turn a student into a weird glitchy figure and then you have to go back to class but the teacherr gives you an impossible question and if you fail he will get mad and start chasing you and if you run into the principal he will try to call the police but then the teacher will knock the principal out and then you have to run around the school and then you have to find something to unlock the doors but then once you escape you run home but then you pass out and wake up in a office and the teacher looks at you and then he turns the office into the school and gets all the students and staff members to help him deffeat you but then a charcter who is glitchy comes to hellp you defeat them and then the storry ends with a sign saying part 2 soon and it is a story game

image_prompt.text: The locked school exit doors that open once the player finds what unlocks them, ending the chase
Lockers, storerooms and under-desk cutouts along the school corridors where a fleeing player breaks the teacher's line of sight
The school interior the player is trapped inside - cafeteria, classrooms, corridors and the principal's office - plus the player's own house in the town
a small town with the player's house and neighbouring homes, connected to the new town's school
an office that turns into a distorted copy of the school for the final confrontation
a sign reading 'part 2 soon' at the end of the story

layout_placement.text: The exit door acting as the escape trigger once unlocked
Where the teacher enters the chase and the corridors he patrols, plus the students and staff he turns against the player
where the glitchy ally character appears to help the player

notes: Chase topology is the reason for P6: the corridors must have zero dead ends or the teacher's pathfinding corners the player unfairly.

The prompt is a linear story across several locations - home town, school, back home, an office that becomes the school. The handoff carries one shape and one flat option list, so the ordering between those locations is not expressed anywhere.
Multiplayer is stated but the roles are not: unclear whether the teacher is AI or a player.

open_questions.ask: Is the town and the school one continuous map, or separate places you load between?
Is the teacher AI-controlled, or is one player the teacher?

coverage_missing.ask: Is the teacher AI or a player role, and can other players be caught too?
Are the town, the school and the office one map or three?
How big is the town - a few houses around your own, or a walkable neighbourhood?

answers.ask: Is the town and the school one continuous map, or separate places you load between?
answers.answer: Use separate places that load between: the small hometown, the new town/school, and the later office-to-school finale. This keeps the story progression clear and the map small.

answers.ask: Is the teacher AI-controlled, or is one player the teacher?
answers.answer: The teacher is AI-controlled. All players experience the same story together and must escape the teacher.
